adapter_initialization: A: normal(0, 0.02); B: zero; RNG not seeded by --seed
adapter_target: all decoder attention q/k/v/o and MLP gate/up/down projections; absent shared-KV v_proj excluded
quantized_backward: first-order input gradients; one transient F32 dequantized projection; frozen base weights
quantized_loading: one dense decoder layer at a time, immediately quantized; no dense base copy retained
quantized_matmul_input_dtype: f32 for Candle CUDA fallback compatibility; output cast to compute dtype
reload: warm start only; optimizer and data-order restart
seed_scope: data order only, not scratch initialization
